sources.title: Nex-N2-Pro official model card
sources.evidence: Names Nex-N2-Pro as an open Nex-N2 variant post-trained from Qwen3.5-397B-A17B. Apache-2.0 front matter; describes coding, deep research, tools and explicit reasoning traces, with parser instructions.

sources.title: Exact Nex-N2-Pro checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration; BF16; 60 layers with 45 linear-attention and 15 full-attention layers; 512 experts, ten selected per token, shared expert, 262144 positions, vision encoder and image/video tokens.

sources.title: Official Qwen3.5-397B-A17B foundation model specification
sources.evidence: The explicitly identified foundation reports nominal 397B total and 17B activated language-model parameters, with Gated DeltaNet/gated-attention MoE layers and ten routed plus one shared expert.

sources.title: Exact Nex-N2-Pro repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public and ungated repository lists 122 weight shards and 396802360816 BF16 tensor elements. Created June 3, 2026; creation is upload chronology, not independent proof of first public release.

sources.title: Exact Nex-N2-Pro checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Index contains 1371 tensor entries, including 333 vision tensors, and 793604721632 bytes. No MTP or scale-named entries appear; storage metadata corroborates nominal size but is not treated as an exact learned-parameter audit.

sources.title: Exact Nex-N2-Pro multimodal processor
sources.evidence: Qwen3VLProcessor contains both image_processor and Qwen3VLVideoProcessor configurations, including video frame sampling at two FPS.

sources.title: Exact Nex-N2-Pro conversation template
sources.evidence: Handles text, image and video input content, explicit thinking traces, function schemas/calls and tool responses; assistant responses are text.

sources.title: Nex-N2 release announcement from the founding institute
sources.evidence: Page displays June 4, 2026 and announces the Nex-N2 release, linking the exact Pro checkpoint. Describes Nex-AGI alliance provenance and adaptive/coherent reasoning for coding, search and tool workflows.

sources.title: Nex-N2-Pro repository history
sources.evidence: Earliest returned commit is a85b319a367e85c544a79e882638964be8238941, dated June 3, 2026 at 17:24:18 UTC. This dates the saved release text, not necessarily when the repository became public.

sources.title: Initial Nex-N2-Pro release card
sources.evidence: Initial card says Pro is being released starting today and mini is not yet open-sourced. Confirms foundation identity and Apache-2.0; prevents treating both variants as simultaneous weight releases.

sources.title: Later Nex-N2.5 first-party comparison card
sources.evidence: Later card references the multimodal foundation of Nex-N2 but its tables concern N2.5 variants, with no replacement parameter specification for original Nex-N2-Pro.

sources.title: Baseline Models.dev record
sources.evidence: Catalog lists June 2, 2026 and links the exact Nex-N2-Pro weights. Used to identify the date conflict, not as primary confirmation.

sources.title: Linked original project repository
sources.evidence: The linked repository, raw README and GitHub commits API returned 404 during this audit; no release-date or technical claim relies on inaccessible contents.

developer.note: Official Nex-AGI repository and founding-institute attribution agree; spaces normalize the display name.

family.note: Normalized Nex-N2 family name, distinct from the later Nex-N2.5 release.

release_date.note: June is verified; earliest public day remains unresolved. June 2 is catalog-only, June 3 dates repository creation/initial release text, and the institute announcement is June 4. Upload/preparation timing is not substituted for first public availability.

open_weights.note: Official release statement and publicly listed ungated BF16 shards establish downloadable weights; no weight shards were downloaded.

license.note: Both initial and current exact model cards declare apache-2.0. No standalone LICENSE file was present at the tested path.

parameters_b.note: Nominal 397B scale of the explicitly named Qwen3.5 foundation, corroborated by the exact checkpoint configuration and approximately 396.802B BF16 storage elements including vision. Not an exact tensor-derived learned-parameter count.

active_parameters_b.note: Separately published nominal 17B activation count for the identified Qwen3.5 language backbone, retained by the matching Nex configuration. It is not calculated from total size; image/video encoder work is additional and input-dependent.

architecture.note: Hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated-attention MoE language model with a vision encoder; 45 linear-attention and 15 full-attention layers, 512 routed experts, ten selected plus one shared expert. MoE is the catalog classification.

context_window.note: Exact Nex text configuration sets max_position_embeddings=262144; no extension from the foundation or a later variant is assumed.

modalities.note: Exact shipped processor includes image and video processing, matching both token types and template branches. Adds the checkpoint video input path omitted by the catalog; hosted endpoint support is not asserted.

reasoning.note: Official card documents explicit reasoning traces and qwen3 reasoning parser; template and adaptive-thinking announcement corroborate.

tool_call.note: Official function-calling instructions and exact template support function schemas, calls and tool responses.

description.value: Open agentic MoE model (397B total, 17B active) for coding, tool use, and research workflows
description.note: Supported concise description; counts are nominal foundation specifications, with active count referring to the language backbone. No benchmark superiority claim is added.

patch.notes: Post-trained from Qwen3.5-397B-A17B. Counts are nominal 397B total / 17B active for the language backbone, corroborated by the matching Nex architecture and approximately 396.802B BF16 checkpoint elements including vision; no exact learned-parameter tensor count is claimed. Vision processing is input-dependent. Exact processor/template support video as well as text/images; hosted routes may differ. June 2026 release is verified, but the earliest public day is unresolved: catalog June 2, repository creation/initial release text June 3, founding-institute announcement June 4. Repository timestamps are not treated as public-release proof.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Added Nex-N2 family, Apache-2.0, nominal 397B total/17B active and exact hybrid MoE architecture. Confirmed 262144 context, open weights, reasoning and tool calls; added video input from exact processor/config/template. Reduced release precision to June 2026 because June 2 lacks primary confirmation and June 3 repository versus June 4 announcement timing does not establish the earliest public day. Later N2.5 material adds no original-model count. Original GitHub project was inaccessible.
